title: Customer Churn Prediction
description: Nimbus was losing subscribers faster than sales could replace them and had no way to flag at-risk accounts before they churned. Our team pulled two years of product usage, billing, and support-ticket data, engineered behavioral features (login cadence, feature adoption, ticket sentiment), and trained a gradient-boosted classifier that reached 89% accuracy on holdout data. We shipped a weekly risk-scored account list to the customer success team, plus a short playbook mapping risk drivers to intervention types. Projected retention lift: $2M in annual recurring revenue saved.

title: Medical Image Classification
description: Trained a CNN classifier to detect anomalies in radiology scans with 94% sensitivity, assisting clinicians in early diagnosis workflows.

title: Supply Chain Demand Forecasting
description: Northwind's warehouses were routinely over-ordering slow-moving SKUs while under-stocking fast movers ahead of peak season, tying up working capital and causing stockouts. We built an LSTM forecasting pipeline on three years of SKU-level sales, promotions, and seasonality data, benchmarked it against their existing moving-average baseline, and integrated it into their replenishment workflow. The model cut inventory overstock by 22% in the first post-launch quarter while holding stockout rates flat, and the team handed off a retraining notebook so Northwind's data team could maintain it independently.

title: Real-Time Sentiment Analysis
description: Fine-tuned a BERT model on social media data to track brand sentiment in real time, processing 10K+ posts daily with sub-second inference.

title: ESG Investment Screening Tool
description: Built an NLP pipeline to extract and score ESG disclosures from SEC filings, enabling systematic socially responsible investing at scale.

title: Customer Segmentation Engine
description: Parallel Co.'s marketing team was running one-size-fits-all campaigns across a customer base with wildly different purchase behavior. We combined K-Means clustering with UMAP dimensionality reduction on 500K+ customer profiles (purchase history, browsing behavior, and demographics) to surface six distinct, actionable segments. Each segment came with a profile deck and recommended messaging angle. Parallel Co.'s next campaign cycle, targeted using our segments, saw a 17% uplift in click-through and conversion versus their prior broad-based approach.

title: Real-Time Fraud Detection
description: Designed a streaming fraud detection system using graph neural networks and feature stores, reducing false positives by 40% versus the legacy rules engine.

A regional food bank network was over-provisioning some distribution sites and running short at others, driving both spoilage and unmet need. We built a lightweight demand forecasting model using historical distribution counts, local demographic data, and seasonal trends, then packaged it into a spreadsheet-based tool the (largely volunteer-run) operations team could use without any coding. Early pilot results estimated a 15% reduction in food waste alongside fewer stockouts at high-need sites.

title: Shelter Resource Allocation Dashboard
description: Built an interactive dashboard helping a homelessness services nonprofit allocate beds and case-manager hours across sites based on real-time intake data.

title: Nonpartisan Voter Turnout Outreach Model
description: TODO: expand with real partner details once confirmed. A nonpartisan civic engagement nonprofit had a fixed canvassing budget and no data-driven way to decide which precincts to prioritize. We trained a turnout propensity model on public voter file and prior-election data, validated it against two past election cycles, and delivered a ranked precinct list with confidence bands. The nonprofit used the ranking to reallocate roughly a third of its canvassing hours toward higher-impact precincts for the following election cycle.
